audit_tool_controls.control: synthetic cross-source mutation must fail while an unmodified strict pair must pass
audit_tool_controls.impact: an audit without known controls may be vacuous

condition_frequency_and_covariation.control: treat this as shortcut diagnostic; held-out component/combination protocol is required before modeling
condition_frequency_and_covariation.impact: condition-only correlation can overstate reaction generalization
condition_frequency_and_covariation.interpretation: condition-only shortcut assessment is descriptive only; no split/model score exists

controls_isolation.control: controls retain a separate table and pair endpoints are checked against main records
controls_isolation.impact: controls mixed into the main matrix would contaminate outcomes

design_position_effects.control: record plate/batch availability and audit their association before any split/model claim
design_position_effects.impact: plate effects can shortcut within-source prediction

identity_group_pair_leakage.control: builder/verifier reject cross-source, cross-group, self-loop and duplicate edges; split leakage is deferred until split manifests exist

measurement_separation.control: all future metrics and splits are source/yield-type stratified
measurement_separation.impact: mixing source yield types invalidates absolute comparisons

missingness_and_zero_pattern.control: retain all records and use yield_observed/zero_yield flags; pairs require observed endpoints
missingness_and_zero_pattern.impact: missing analysis and observed zero can bias eligibility

pair_degree_imbalance.control: report degree distribution and require group-aware pair reporting in the later protocol
pair_degree_imbalance.impact: high-degree nodes can dominate pair metrics

pretraining_contamination.control: no pretrained model is used; any later model must declare contamination risk
pretraining_contamination.impact: public-data overlap can invalidate a clean-pretraining claim
pretraining_contamination.reason: no pretrained model is used or evaluated in this phase

structure_scaffold_coverage.control: declare scaffold/template tasks not_supported rather than deriving proxies
structure_scaffold_coverage.impact: unsupported structures cannot justify scaffold leakage claims
structure_scaffold_coverage.reason: Benchmark v0.1 scaffold/template groups are contractually not_supported because complete verified reaction structures are absent

scope: strict candidate only; no pretraining, split, or model result
